title: ql_report.conflict_mrs picks the list's fields by the url's forge, not the forge setting bl_forge.read_list now aims at
goal: ql_report.conflict_mrs reads the fields of the list by the forge the list was read from (the CLI forge_list returns: gh is github, glab is gitlab, which follows the forge setting, else the url's), so a GitHub Enterprise host named by forge github lists its conflict merge requests as #N from headRefName, and a gitlab url still lists them as !N from source_branch

run: import json,os,sys,tempfile; sys.path.insert(0,"_tools"); c=os.path.join(tempfile.mkdtemp(),"backlog.json"); json.dump({"forge":"github"},open(c,"w")); os.environ["KB_BACKLOG_CONFIG"]=c; import ql_report; run=lambda a,cwd=None:(0,json.dumps([{"number":3,"title":"t","headRefName":"querylog/r1","url":"u"}]),""); d,_=ql_report.conflict_mrs("https://ghe.corp.example.com/group/kb.git",run); sys.exit(0 if d and d[0][0]=="#3" else 1)

import json, os, subprocess, sys, tempfile
CHILD = """import json,sys;sys.path.insert(0,"_tools");import ql_report
url,data=sys.argv[1],json.loads(sys.argv[2])
d,_=ql_report.conflict_mrs(url,lambda a,cwd=None:(0,json.dumps(data),""))
print(json.dumps(d))"""
def case(forge, url, data):
    c = os.path.join(tempfile.mkdtemp(), "backlog.json"); json.dump({"forge": forge}, open(c, "w"))
    p = subprocess.run([sys.executable, "-c", CHILD, url, json.dumps(data)], capture_output=True, text=True, env=dict(os.environ, KB_BACKLOG_CONFIG=c))
    try:
        return json.loads(p.stdout)
    except ValueError:
        return None
lab = case("gitlab", "https://gitlab.example.com/group/kb.git", [{"iid": 4, "title": "t", "source_branch": "querylog/r1", "web_url": "u"}])
hub = case("github", "https://ghe.corp.example.com/group/kb.git", [{"number": 3, "title": "t", "headRefName": "querylog/r1", "url": "u"}])
lab_ok = bool(lab) and lab[0][0] == "!4" and lab[0][1] == "querylog/r1"
hub_ok = bool(hub) and hub[0][0] == "#3" and hub[0][1] == "querylog/r1"
print("gitlab:", lab_ok, "github enterprise host:", hub_ok)
sys.exit(0 if lab_ok and hub_ok else 1)
